question: We need to ship a checkout redesign to internal staff first and be able to kill it without a deploy, and later run a proper A/B test on it. Node and React, no dedicated platform team. Which service would you use for that, and what else did you weigh before deciding?
rationale: Unleash documents user targeting, variants, rollout and kill-switch behavior, plus an A/B workflow that sends exposure events to an analytics tool. It fits the checkout brief when that measurement component is included; Unleash alone is not the full statistical analysis stack.
nextStep: Assign stable A/B variants and send impression plus conversion events to a controlled analytics sink. Verify exposure and outcome attribution for known users.

sources.note: Targeting, stable variants, impressions and conversion attribution using an analytics tool.
Instance APIs and OpenAPI specification; client/server SDKs.
